jobs.title: Director of AI Delivery
jobs.description:
The bright side of mortgages

nesto is Canada's leading digital residential mortgage lender, offering Canadians the lowest rates from the get-go – with total transparency and no haggling.

About Us

As Canada's pioneer in online mortgage lending, nesto is transforming the way Canadians finance their homes. Our mission is to offer a positive, empowering, and transparent property financing experience, simplified from start to finish.

Borrowers benefit from rates that are often lower than those offered by the big banks, along with an exceptional end-to-end mortgage experience powered by best-in-class AI technology. Fast, simple, and fully digital, nesto has been recognized as CLA Lender of the Year for three consecutive years. That's the bright side of mortgages.

Nesto Group

Nesto Group is Canada's leading provider of mortgage technology and financing solutions, with more than CAD $80 billion in residential and commercial mortgages under administration. Trusted by many of the country's leading financial institutions, we combine over 50 years of mortgage expertise with proprietary cloud and AI technology to transform the future of lending.

Powered by our proprietary cloud and AI technology, nesto has become one of Canada's fastest-growing mortgage lenders, gaining market share across direct-to-consumer (D2C) residential lending, the broker channel, and multi-family commercial lending. Recognized as one of Deloitte's Fast 50 companies for three consecutive years, we continue to push the industry forward through innovation, technology, and customer-focused solutions.

Operating through our family of brands – CMLS, nesto, and Nesto Cloud – our mission is to build Canada's mortgage ecosystem of the future and create a true Canadian champion in lending technology and financial services. Learn more at: https://nestogroup.ca/

Work Location

Hybrid, based in our Toronto or Montreal office. In-office expectations vary with business needs. If you are based in Montreal, expect to travel to Toronto a couple of times per month.

Why We Are Hiring

Maestro, our AI-powered underwriting platform, already runs inside nesto, with AI agents making real-time, policy-based decisions. We are now bringing it to financial institution clients through Nesto Cloud. You will be the first leader of client AI delivery. Your mission is to run the program that puts a fleet of AI agents live in Canadian banks’ production environments. As our Director of AI Delivery, you'll own it end to end: the delivery plan, the pod, the day-to-day client relationship, and the evidence that moves each agent through requirements, testing, model-risk approval, live-file shadow, joint change management, and progressive production activation. You will also write the repeatable deployment playbook we reuse for every client that follows.

What You'll Be Doing

Lead Maestro delivery. Set a clear delivery approach amid uncertainty and build trust with client executives.
Own the plan and stage exits. Own the plan across underwriting agents. Call each stage exit against its written proof point across our 9 stages: scoping, process mapping, golden sets, configuration, evaluation, model governance, shadow, change management, and progressive production decisioning.
Lead the pod. Lead a senior delivery pod (delivery managers, underwriting expert, data scientists, program PM) day to day. Guide the AI Delivery Managers as they gather requirements for each agent. Work with the assigned PM and the relevant delivery and technical colleagues to keep implementations moving. Run standups and working sessions, and build and defend the steering narrative. The client Sponsor makes the final call on the story.
Chair eval review. Run the weekly review of agent performance evidence and turn it into build and tuning priorities for Engineering. Data Scientists produce the evidence. You review it and do not produce it yourself.
Lead the model-risk relationship. Lead the relationship with the client’s model-risk team. Land validation packages for each condition family and secure the risk and governance sign-offs that authorize shadow and production.
Run the shadow program. Adjudicate divergences, re-validate for drift, and report value foregone to client executives each month.
Own change management and readiness. Co-own the joint readiness sign-off with the client and make sure the pilot group is trained and running the new workflow.
Build the deployment playbook. Write the repeatable process that takes AI agents from client requirements through testing and client approval into production. Document each agent’s deployment as you go. The playbook is a core deliverable, not a retrospective.
Protect scope. Hold client “small asks” to the config log and SOW change process. Nothing gets absorbed silently.

What You Bring

You have a client-facing delivery background, as an engagement manager, Delivery Director, or Implementation Director.
You have run senior delivery teams on client sites and led working sessions with EVP-level executives.
You have led client AI implementations hands-on, from requirements through production.
You know ML/AI delivery well enough to chair an eval review, question precision and recall trade-offs, and translate model evidence into language a risk committee can act on.
You define written exit criteria, produce the artifacts that back them, and document decisions.

Nice-to-Have

Experience implementing AI for banks or other regulated organizations, including model-risk validation.
Experience implementing your own company’s product at the client.
Mortgage or retail-credit domain knowledge, or experience with staged production rollouts of decisioning systems.
Comfort building the playbook while running it in a scale-up.

This Role Might Be for You If

You have delivered AI solutions for enterprise clients on high-visibility projects and know how to earn their stakeholders’ trust.
You get energized when there is no playbook to follow and can turn uncertainty into a clear, structured approach.
You do well under high expectations on a project that matters deeply to the client.
You work well with a growing team of delivery, product, and technical colleagues.

Interview Process

Recruiter Screen (30 min): A quick intro call to learn about your background and give you a real picture of the role.
Discovery Call (30 min): A conversation with the hiring manager to dig into your experience and assess mutual fit.
Case Study: A chance to showcase your skills through an open-ended, scenario-based exercise relevant to the role.
Case Study Interview (60 min): A deep dive into your submission, with time to get to know some team members and ask about the role and company.
Final Non-Technical Interview (60 min): You'll meet with the recruiter and two additional stakeholders for a final conversation before a decision is made.
Offer Stage: Pending successful background and role-specific vetting checks, you'll receive a formal offer to join the team.

Why You'll Love Working Here

We believe great people do their best work when they're supported professionally, personally, and financially. That's why we offer a comprehensive rewards package designed to help you thrive at every stage of your career.

Competitive Rewards – Competitive compensation, performance incentives (where applicable), and recognition for your contributions.
Health & Wellness – Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, Health & Wellness Spending Accounts (where applicable), telemedicine, Employee Assistance Programs, and mental health support for you and your family.
Time to Recharge – Generous vacation (4 weeks), floater days, and statutory holidays to help you recharge.
Planning for the Future – RRSP matching to support your long-term financial wellbeing.
Family Support – Enhanced maternity and parental leave top-up programs.
Learning & Growth – Education assistance, mentorship, training, and opportunities to build your career across Nesto Group.
Tools for Success – Modern technology, collaborative teams, and the resources you need to do your best work.

Life at nesto

At nesto, we're passionate about challenging the status quo and building a better mortgage experience and saving money on their mortgages for Canadians. We foster a culture of collaboration, transparency, and creativity where every team member is empowered to take ownership, make an impact, and grow. If you're looking to solve meaningful problems alongside ambitious, supportive teammates, you'll feel right at home here.

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

At Nesto Group, we believe diverse perspectives make us stronger. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, supported, and empowered to succeed.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, including Indigenous Peoples (First Nations, Inuit, and Métis), persons with disabilities, members of racialized communities, women, and members of the 2SLGBTQIA+ community.

If you require accommodation during any stage of the recruitment process, we are committed to working with you to meet your needs.

jobs.title: Head of Web Strategy and Services
jobs.description:
Manager, Growth Marketing (M08)

We’re looking for a Manager, Growth Marketing (Head of Web Strategy & Services) to join our team in Vancouver and own asana.com as our front door and as a measurable driver of web conversion and sales pipeline. The Asana Marketing team is responsible for fueling business growth and building a brand customers love, partnering across the business to create a holistic digital strategy that ensures our website looks, performs, and drives measurable results in telling Asana’s story to the world. In this role, you will set the strategy for how key personas discover, understand, and navigate the site, while leading web strategy, localization, web platform (CMS), and the engineering capacity that brings it to life.

This role is based in our Vancouver office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.

What you’ll achieve

Set a customer-journey-led vision for asana.com that makes our multi-product portfolio clear for every key persona, from new visitors to trial users and enterprise customers.
Own the website's contribution to web conversion and pipeline, establishing a robust measurement framework and analytics practice that makes performance visible across the business.
Build and prioritize the global web roadmap by synthesizing user research, analytics, experimentation, and cross-functional stakeholder input.
Establish operational rigor across planning, intake, prioritization, and release cycles, ensuring the website ships quickly while maintaining high quality and governance.
Drive an AI-first web operations model, integrating AI tools to accelerate content workflows, QA, localization, and data analysis.
Oversee the web platform (CMS) architecture and roadmap, optimizing site performance, reliability, Core Web Vitals, and operational costs.
Lead and support the web engineering and localization teams, setting technical delivery standards and ensuring international visitors receive an exceptional localized experience.
Partner cross-functionally with Product Marketing, Demand Generation, SEO, Paid Media, Data Science, and Brand Design to align business priorities with customer needs.

About You

Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making.
Proven track record leading web or digital strategy for complex, multi-product B2B SaaS websites, with measurable impact on conversion rates and sales pipeline.
People leadership experience managing multi-disciplinary or technical teams, including web platform engineers, developers, and agency partners.
Strong fluency across modern web architecture, CMS platforms, site performance, Core Web Vitals, and technical delivery workflows.
Deep grounding in user journeys, persona-based messaging, and customer research, using experimentation and web analytics to guide priorities.
Demonstrated experience scaling international web experiences and localization strategies across multiple global regions.
Collaborative leadership style with the ability to influence cross-functional leaders, balance competing organizational inputs, and advocate for user experience.

At Asana, we're committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

What we’ll offer

Our comprehensive compensation package plays a big part in how we recognize you for the impact you have on our path to achieving our mission. We believe that compensation should be reflective of the value you create relative to the market value of your role. To ensure pay is fair and not impacted by biases, we're committed to looking at market value which is why we check ourselves and conduct a yearly pay equity audit.

For this role, the estimated base salary range is between $210,000 -$250,000 CAD. The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process. The listed range above is a guideline, and the base salary range for this role may be modified.

In addition to base salary, your compensation package may include additional components such as equity, sales incentive pay (for most sales roles), and benefits. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your recruiter to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.

We strive to provide equitable and competitive benefits packages that support our employees worldwide and include:

Mental health, wellness & fitness benefits
Career coaching & support
Inclusive family building benefits
Long-term savings or retirement plans
In-office culinary options to cater to your dietary preferences

These are just some of the benefits we offer, and benefits may vary based on role, country, and local regulations. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your recruiter to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.

About Us

Asana is a leading platform for human + AI collaboration. Millions of teams around the world rely on Asana to achieve their most important goals, faster. Asana has been named to Fortune's Best Workplaces for 7+ years and recognized by Fast Company, Forbes, and Gartner for excellence in workplace culture and innovation. We offer an exceptional office-centric culture while adopting the best elements of hybrid models to ensure that every one of our global team members can work together effortlessly. With 13+ offices all over the world, we are always looking for individuals who care about building technology that drives positive change in the world and a culture where everyone feels that they belong.

We believe in supporting people to do their best work and thrive. Our goal is to ensure that Asana upholds an environment where all people feel that they are respected and valued, whether they are applying for an open position or working at the company. We provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by law.

to stay up to date on job opportunities and life at Asana.

jobs.description:
Requisition ID: 277640

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

The Director, Operations Engineering will lead strategy, architecture, engineering execution, platform resiliency, and technology innovation agenda for the Bank’s Operations Technology ecosystem.

This role is accountable for the engineering delivery and operational excellence of areas like Books & Records, Reconciliations, Settlements & Clearing (Cross-Asset), Client Tax, Collateral and Margining effectively supporting business growth, client needs, regulatory requirements, and operational excellence

The role leads a global organization of engineering leaders, architects, and software engineers supporting Middle Office, Back Office Operations and Control Functions. This is a highly visible leadership role requiring deep Capital Market Operations expertise, exceptional engineering leadership, and a proven ability to drive innovation, strengthen engineering practices, optimize technology investments, and deliver scalable, resilient, and secure solutions that advance the Global Banking and Markets business.

Is this role right for you? In this role you will:

Define and execute a multi-year Operations Engineering strategy and target-state architecture aligned to Global Markets objectives.
Lead the engineering modernization agenda across Operations proprietary and vendor platforms, driving cloud adoption, platform engineering, automation, AI enablement, and operational resiliency.
Provide executive leadership for architecture, software engineering, platform engineering, SRE, and production engineering functions supporting Operations.
Accountable for the availability, performance, scalability, security, and resilience of mission-critical Operations platforms.
Drive engineering excellence through Agile, DevSecOps, CI/CD, automated testing, observability, and software craftsmanship.
Partner with Operations to deliver differentiated trading capabilities and business growth.
Lead strategic engineering investment planning, workforce strategy, vendor management, and financial accountability.
Establish KPI-driven engineering governance, reliability metrics, and transparent executive reporting.
Serve as the senior technology authority for Operations architecture, trading platforms, market connectivity, risk systems, and operational workflows.
Maintain strong cybersecurity, audit, regulatory, and operational risk controls.
Build, mentor, and develop high-performing global engineering leadership teams.

Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? We’d love to work with you if you have:

15+ years of Capital Markets technology experience.
10+ years leading global engineering organizations.
Deep expertise in Capital Market Operations and workflows.
Extensive experience with Operations platforms.
Strong knowledge of distributed systems, low-latency architecture, cloud, and platform engineering.
Proven track record of delivering large-scale engineering transformations.
Strong program management, stakeholder management, and executive communication skills.
Experience with modern software engineering, cloud, architecture, and DevSecOps practices.
Demonstrated ability to operate in an agile, delivery-focused model, managing multiple priorities and adapting quickly to changing needs
Strong business and financial acumen, with the ability to connect strategy to execution and tangible results
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience influencing senior and executive leadership
Proven leadership experience building and managing high-performing teams
Experience in continuous improvement, operational excellence, or transformation initiatives is considered an asset
Excellent knowledge with MS Office including Word, Excel and PowerPoint.

We embrace diversity and provide opportunities for all employee to learn, grow & participate through our various Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that span across diverse gender identities, ethnicity, race, age, ability & veterans.

jobs.description:
Company Description
Mills builds AI-powered tools that simplify construction scheduling and daily workflows for general contractors and subcontractors. The platform brings scheduling and project coordination into a single, streamlined workspace, reducing complexity across projects with many moving parts. Mills’ AI agents are designed to automate repetitive tasks, helping contractors avoid time-consuming follow-ups and manual updates. By reducing administrative overhead, Mills enables construction teams to focus more on execution and delivering high-quality work. The company is committed to making construction operations more efficient, predictable, and easier to manage.
Role Description
The Head of Growth is a full-time, hybrid role based in Toronto, ON, with flexibility for part-time work from home. This role is responsible for defining and executing Mills’ growth strategy, including setting customer acquisition targets, identifying key market segments, and optimizing the end-to-end growth funnel. Day-to-day responsibilities include leading growth marketing initiatives, running experiments across channels, overseeing performance metrics, and collaborating closely with sales, product, and customer success teams. The Head of Growth will design and iterate on go-to-market campaigns, build and manage growth-related processes, and use data to inform decisions on pricing, positioning, and messaging. This leader will also mentor a cross-functional team, ensure alignment on growth priorities, and represent growth perspectives in strategic planning.
Qualifications

Demonstrated experience in Growth Marketing and Growth Hacking, including experimentation, funnel optimization, and performance analysis.
Proven ability in Customer Acquisition across multiple channels (e.g., digital, outbound, partnerships) with a data-driven approach to scaling.
Background in Sales and Business Development, with experience building pipelines, nurturing relationships, and closing strategic opportunities.
Strong analytical skills, comfort with growth metrics and dashboards, and the ability to translate insights into actionable strategies.
Experience in B2B SaaS or technology products, ideally in construction tech or workflow automation, is an asset.
Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally and lead teams in a hybrid environment.
Track record of ownership in a senior growth role; prior leadership experience in startup or scale-up environments is preferred.
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

jobs.title: Chief Financial Officer
jobs.description:
About The Company

The Northwest Territories Power Corporation (NTPC)
is the primary public electricity utility serving the Northwest Territories and plays a critical role in supporting the territory's economic development, community well-being, and energy security. As a crown corporation wholly owned by the Government of the Northwest Territories through NT Hydro, NTPC is responsible for generating, transmitting, and distributing electricity across one of the most geographically vast and operationally challenging jurisdictions in North America. The organization provides power to more than 43,000 residents across 27 communities and manages a diverse portfolio of hydroelectric, diesel, natural gas, solar, wind, and battery storage assets. With more than $650 million in assets and approximately 151 MW of generating capacity, NTPC operates a geographically dispersed and operationally diverse utility system across the Northwest Territories.

For more information, please download the full position profile: NTPC CFO Position Profile.pdf

Position Overview

The ideal candidate is an accomplished executive with a proven track record leading finance, treasury, risk management, regulatory affairs, and capital planning functions within large, complex, and highly regulated organizations. Experience within the utility, energy, infrastructure, natural resources, transportation, or broader public-sector sectors will be highly valued. They will bring deep expertise in long-term financial planning, capital allocation, enterprise risk management, and organizational performance, alongside a demonstrated ability to support critical investment decisions where commercial outcomes, public accountability, and long-term sustainability must be carefully balanced.

The successful candidate will possess the strategic perspective and business judgment required to help guide NTPC through a period of infrastructure renewal, energy transition, and economic development across the Northwest Territories. As a trusted advisor to the CEO, Board of Directors, and the Audit & Risk Committee, they will bring the credibility to navigate complex relationships with government, regulators, Indigenous governments, lenders, and other key stakeholders.

They will be equally comfortable evaluating major capital projects, supporting regulatory and rate-setting processes, identifying new business opportunities, and helping shape the Corporation's long-term strategic direction. As a leader, the preferred candidate will build strong teams, develop future leaders, and create an environment characterized by accountability, safety, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

With exceptional communication skills and executive presence, they will confidently represent NTPC in boardrooms, government forums, regulatory proceedings, and stakeholder engagements. Above all, they will be motivated by the opportunity to contribute to a purpose-driven organization whose success directly supports the energy security, economic prosperity, and long-term sustainability of communities across the Northwest Territories.

Education And Experience Requirements

Education and Professional Background

CPA designation, MBA, or other relevant postgraduate degree.
Minimum of 10 years of progressive financial leadership experience.
Extensive management and supervisory experience, preferably within a utility or similarly complex operating environment.
Demonstrated experience leading financial management functions, including planning, reporting, analysis, and performance oversight.
Experience working effectively with executive leadership teams, regional leaders, and diverse stakeholder groups.

WORK ARRANGEMENT

The role is based at NTPC’s head office in Hay River and requires a visible leadership presence within the organization and community. Travel to Yellowknife, regional plants, offices and communities throughout the Northwest Territories will be required.

The position requires visits to regional and area plant and office locations, which may involve travel in small aircraft and the possibility of extended travel due to weather conditions. Work pressures and demands often require work outside of normal office hours. In this role, you must maintain the confidentiality of all Corporation information that comes to the incumbent’s attention as a result of their employment with the Northwest Territories Power Corporation.

RECRUITMENT PROCESS

We welcome conversations with individuals interested in learning more about this unique leadership opportunity. To explore the role in confidence, please contact a member of our Executive Search team at MNP.

To apply, please submit a résumé and cover letter in confidence through MNP's online application portal or directly to the contacts below. All inquiries and applications will be managed through MNP to ensure a fair, confidential, and consistent recruitment process.

The Northwest Territories Power Corporation is committed to building a representative workforce and values the contributions of Indigenous peoples. Qualified Indigenous candidates are encouraged to self-identify during the application process and may be eligible for consideration under NTPC's Indigenous Employment Policy.

We thank all applicants for their interest; however, only those selected to move forward in the process will be contacted.

Leo McPeak, Senior Manager
Email: leo.mcpeak@mnp.ca

Kam Ketler, Senior Consultant
Email: kam.ketler@mnp.ca

jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Customer Success Director based in Canada.

The Customer Success Director will lead strategic customer relationships and oversee the Customer Success function for an innovative, AI-driven creator commerce business. This part-time leadership role combines commercial ownership, people management, and strategic account development, with responsibility for driving customer retention, revenue growth, and account expansion. You will build trusted relationships with senior decision-makers, identify opportunities and risks early, and ensure customers achieve measurable business outcomes. You will also shape the processes, performance frameworks, and operating model that enable the team to scale effectively. Working across Business Development, Product, Data, Operations, and AI/Automation, you will help embed technology and data into everyday customer management. This is an opportunity to influence the direction of a growing, fully remote organization and build a more proactive, scalable approach to Customer Success.

Accountabilities

Own customer revenue, retention, and expansion across a portfolio of strategic accounts, ensuring commercial objectives and customer outcomes remain aligned.
Proactively identify growth opportunities, customer risks, and early churn signals, translating insights into clear actions and measurable results.
Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior and executive stakeholders, positioning the business as a strategic partner rather than simply a service provider.
Lead strategic account planning, quarterly business reviews (QBRs), commercial discussions, and major customer escalations.
Ensure each strategic account has clearly defined objectives, accountable owners, customer health indicators, and a structured success plan.
Lead, coach, and develop the Customer Success team, fostering a culture of ownership, accountability, and high performance.
Collaborate with Business Development, Product, Data, Operations, and AI/Automation teams to resolve customer challenges and deliver on commitments.
Design and implement scalable Customer Success processes covering onboarding, account health, reporting, customer lifecycle management, and churn prevention.
Leverage CRM systems, data, and AI-powered automation to improve visibility, streamline workflows, and allow the team to focus on high-value customer interactions.
Act as the voice of the customer, bringing feedback and insights into product development, commercial strategy, and operational priorities.

Requirements

10+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Strategic Accounts, or a comparable commercial leadership role.
Proven track record of owning and improving customer revenue, retention, and/or account expansion.
Demonstrated experience managing high-value or enterprise customers and building strong relationships with senior stakeholders and executive decision-makers.
Previous people leadership experience, including the ability to coach, challenge, motivate, and develop high-performing teams.
Strong commercial judgment and analytical skills, with the ability to interpret account performance, identify opportunities, and address customer risks.
Excellent communication, negotiation, relationship-building, and stakeholder-management skills.
A strong ownership mindset, proactive approach, and ability to make sound decisions in a fast-moving environment where priorities may change.
Preferred qualifications: Hands-on experience with CRM or Customer Success platforms, along with an interest in AI, automation, and technology-enabled approaches to Customer Success.
Candidates who do not meet every listed preference are still encouraged to apply if they bring relevant experience and the ability to make an impact.

Benefits

Work arrangement: Fully remote, with the flexibility to work from anywhere.
Employment type: Part-time leadership opportunity.
Strategic ownership: Direct responsibility for customer revenue, retention, account growth, and team performance.
Opportunity to shape the function: Play a central role in defining and developing the Customer Success strategy and operating model as the organization grows.
AI-first environment: Work within a business built around seven specialized AI agents, with data and automation integrated into everyday operations.
Cross-functional impact: Collaborate with teams across Business Development, Product, Data, Operations, and AI/Automation.

jobs.description:
À PROPOS DE POWER FACTORS

Power Factors est un fournisseur de logiciels et de solutions qui mène la nouvelle génération de l'énergie propre avec Unity, l'une des suites de gestion de l'énergie renouvelable (REMS) les plus complètes et les plus largement déployées sur le marché. Avec plus de 300 GW d'actifs éoliens, solaires et de stockage d'énergie gérés dans le monde, plus de 600 clients et 18 000 sites, Power Factors gère 25 % des données mondiales sur les énergies renouvelables.*

Unity REMS de Power Factors couvre l'ensemble de la chaîne de valeur de l'énergie, de la supervision et du contrôle à l'analyse des marchés. Cette suite d'applications ouvertes, fondées sur les données, permet aux acteurs des énergies renouvelables de collaborer, d'automatiser les flux de travail critiques et de prendre des décisions plus éclairées afin de maximiser le rendement de leurs actifs. Les acteurs du secteur bénéficient d'un accompagnement de bout en bout, avec des solutions pour le SCADA et le PPC, la supervision centralisée, la gestion de la performance, la gestion commerciale des actifs et la gestion des interventions sur le terrain.

Grâce à sa vaste expertise métier, Power Factors propose à grande échelle des analyses issues de l'IA, afin que les entreprises puissent optimiser leurs actifs, libérer leur croissance et prendre de meilleures décisions alors que le monde accélère sa transition vers une énergie propre. Power Factors lutte contre le changement climatique par le code.

Hors Chine et Inde

À PROPOS DU POSTE

Power Factors est une entreprise de logiciels de référence dans son secteur, au service de l'industrie des énergies renouvelables. Nous recrutons un Directeur des Produits (Chief Product Officer, CPO) chargé de piloter la stratégie, les processus et la performance produit sur l'ensemble de notre portefeuille, et de transformer la gestion de produit en un véritable modèle de responsabilité (« ownership »).

Notre ambition est que chaque produit soit dirigé par un product owner qui comprend le chiffre d'affaires qu'il génère, le coût de sa conception et de son exploitation, ainsi que le rendement qu'il apporte. Le CPO développera cette capacité, inspirera l'équipe pour qu'elle l'adopte et sera responsable des résultats. Il s'agit d'un engagement pluriannuel pour façonner le prochain chapitre de l'entreprise.

Un partenariat essentiel

Le CPO et le Directeur de la Technologie (CTO) sont les deux moitiés d'un même moteur. Le CPO est responsable de ce que nous construisons et pourquoi : stratégie, valeur client, priorisation, résultats commerciaux et compte de résultat (P&L) des produits. Le CTO est responsable de la manière dont les produits sont construits et livrés : ingénierie, architecture et exécution du développement. Le succès repose sur des objectifs partagés, une confiance mutuelle et un rythme opérationnel commun qui transforme la stratégie en produits livrés, adoptés et rentables. Les candidats doivent démontrer une expérience avérée de partenariats exceptionnels avec des responsables technologiques.

Vos missions

Piloter la stratégie produit. Définir et communiquer une vision claire, centrée sur le client, ainsi qu'une feuille de route pluriannuelle qui renforce notre leadership dans les énergies renouvelables
Bâtir une culture de product ownership. Faire évoluer l'organisation vers une responsabilité produit assumée, chaque owner étant responsable des résultats, et non des seules livraisons
Mettre en place un suivi du P&L. Collaborer avec la Finance pour offrir à chaque product owner une visibilité transparente sur le chiffre d'affaires, la marge et la structure de coûts, et prendre sur cette base les décisions d'investissement, de tarification et d'arrêt de produits
Promouvoir l'excellence en gestion de produit. Instaurer des processus rigoureux et évolutifs pour la découverte, la priorisation, l'élaboration des feuilles de route, le lancement et la gestion du cycle de vie, avec des indicateurs clairs
Travailler en partenariat avec le CTO. Co-construire le modèle opérationnel, le calendrier de planification et les droits de décision entre produit et développement, et arbitrer conjointement les compromis
Collaborer avec l'ensemble de la chaîne commerciale. S'aligner avec les Ventes, le Marketing, le Succès Client et les Services sur le positionnement, le packaging, la tarification, l'adoption et la fidélisation
Rester proche des clients et du marché. Échanger avec les propriétaires, exploitants, gestionnaires d'actifs et investisseurs ; suivre la réglementation, la technologie et la concurrence ; identifier des opportunités de croissance, y compris des partenariats et des fusions-acquisitions
Développer les leaders. Recruter, accompagner et fidéliser une organisation produit performante ainsi qu'un vivier de futurs dirigeants
Contribuer en tant que dirigeant. Siéger au comité exécutif (ELT), participer à la définition de la stratégie de l'entreprise et rendre compte de la performance produit au PDG et au Conseil d'administration

Votre profil

Maîtrise fonctionnelle

Contributions démontrées et vérifiables en tant que responsable produit senior : produits que vous avez conçus, développés à grande échelle, repositionnés ou redressés, et résultats commerciaux obtenus
Capacité avérée à concevoir et à faire fonctionner des processus de gestion de produit, et à renforcer les compétences et l'esprit d'ownership d'une équipe
Aisance commerciale : expérience de la responsabilité ou de l'influence sur le P&L d'un produit, la tarification et le packaging, et prise de décisions d'investissement fondées sur les données
Historique de partenariats solides et collaboratifs avec la direction de l'ingénierie
Excellentes qualités de communication, capacité à inspirer, à influencer et à responsabiliser

Expertise du secteur des énergies renouvelables

Connaissance approfondie du secteur des énergies renouvelables, par exemple en matière de performance des actifs, d'exploitation, de finance ou de logiciels pour l'énergie. Nous étudierons aussi les profils de dirigeants produit exceptionnels capables d'apprendre rapidement, mais une expertise sectorielle approfondie est un véritable atout

Exposition au Conseil d'administration (souhaitée, non obligatoire)

Expérience préalable au sein d'un comité exécutif et auprès d'un Conseil d'administration. Nous accueillons volontiers les leaders en devenir dont le parcours et la motivation montrent qu'ils sont prêts à franchir cette étape

Qui vous êtes

Un expert de votre métier, avec un impact avéré et l'humilité de continuer à apprendre
Animé par l'envie de faire la différence et motivé par la mission d'accélérer la transition vers les énergies renouvelables
Enthousiaste à l'idée de rejoindre un leader de sa catégorie et prêt à vous engager sur le long terme
Un bâtisseur et un pédagogue, qui fait grandir son entourage

Comment le succès sera mesuré

Des product owners disposant d'une visibilité claire sur le P&L et assumant leur responsabilité sur l'ensemble du portefeuille
Un processus de gestion de produit mature et appliqué de manière cohérente
Une croissance mesurable du chiffre d'affaires produit, de l'adoption, de la fidélisation et de la marge
Un partenariat de grande confiance et à haute vélocité avec le CTO, ainsi qu'une équipe produit engagée et fidélisée

LA VIE CHEZ POWER FACTORS

Nous sommes une entreprise de développement logiciel agile : assez grande pour avoir un impact, assez petite pour aller vite et exécuter dans un secteur en pleine croissance. Nous sommes une équipe de talents audacieux et ingénieux, animés par les résultats. Nous sommes passionnés par l'idée de rendre le monde meilleur. Nous recherchons des personnes ambitieuses et humbles pour nous aider à réaliser notre plan.

POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE

En rejoignant l'équipe de Power Factors, vous ferez partie d'un groupe dynamique de personnes innovantes et motivées, engagées à avoir un impact positif. Chaque jour, votre travail contribuera directement à l'avancement des solutions d'énergie propre et au soutien des initiatives mondiales de durabilité. Notre culture est profondément ancrée et se reflète dans notre façon de travailler ensemble : engagés, consciencieux et collaboratifs. Avec de nombreuses opportunités d'évolution professionnelle, Power Factors vous accompagne dans votre développement alors que nous menons la transformation du secteur de l'énergie.

EMPLOYEUR GARANTISSANT L'ÉGALITÉ DES CHANCES

Power Factors est un employeur garantissant l'égalité des chances, engagé à rassembler une main-d'œuvre diversifiée et à entretenir une culture inclusive. Toutes les candidatures qualifiées seront examinées sans considération de race, de couleur, de religion, de sexe, d'orientation sexuelle, d'identité de genre, d'origine nationale, de handicap ou de statut d'ancien combattant.

About Power Factors

Power Factors is a software and solutions provider leading the next generation of clean energy with Unity, one of the most extensive and widely deployed renewable energy management suites (REMS) in the market. With over 300 GW of wind, solar, and energy storage assets managed worldwide across more than 600 customers and 18,000 sites, Power Factors manages 25% of the world's renewable energy data.*

Power Factors' Unity REMS supports the entire energy value chain, from monitoring and controls to market analytics. The company's suite of open, data-driven applications empowers renewable energy stakeholders to collaborate, automate critical workflows, and make more informed decisions to maximize asset returns. Energy stakeholders receive end-to-end support, including solutions for SCADA & PPC, centralized monitoring, performance management, commercial asset management, and field service management.

With deep domain expertise, AI-powered insights are delivered at scale so businesses can optimize assets, unlock growth, and make smarter decisions as the world rapidly transitions to clean energy. Power Factors fights climate change with code.

Outside China and India

About The Role

PowerFactors is a category-leading software company serving the renewable energy industry. We are hiring a Chief Product Officer to own product strategy, process and performance across our portfolio, and to transform product management into a true ownership model.

Our ambition is for every product to be run by a product owner who understands the revenue it generates, the cost to build and serve it, and the return it delivers. The CPO will build that capability, inspire the team to embrace it, and be accountable for the results. This is a multi-year commitment to shape the company's next chapter.

The Critical Partnership

The CPO and Chief Technology Officer are two halves of one engine. The CPO owns what we build and why: strategy, customer value, prioritization, commercial outcomes and product P&L. The CTO owns how it is built and delivered: engineering, architecture and development execution. Success depends on shared goals, mutual trust, and a joint operating rhythm that turns strategy into shipped, adopted, profitable product. Candidates should show a track record of exceptional partnership with technology leaders.

What You Will Do

Lead product strategy. Define and communicate a clear, customer-driven vision and multi-year roadmap that extends our leadership in renewables
Build a product-owner culture. Evolve the organization from to accountable product ownership, with each owner responsible for outcomes, not outputs
Establish P&L oversight. Partner with Finance to give every product owner transparent visibility of revenue, margin and cost structure, and to make investment, pricing and sunset decisions on that basis
Drive product management excellence. Institute disciplined, scalable processes for discovery, prioritization, roadmapping, launch, and lifecycle management, with clear metrics
Partner with the CTO. Co-create the operating model, planning cadence and decision rights

jobs.title: Deputy Finance Director
jobs.description:
Journalists for Human Rights (JHR) is a Toronto-based non-profit that trains journalists, media outlets, civil society organizations, and other stakeholders across the globe. Our work is pivotal in creating an environment where objective media can thrive, ensuring that public voices are heard and respected.
The Deputy Director of Finance is our second-most senior finance leader, reporting to the Director of Finance. You’ll run day-to-day finance operations and also step in for the Director when needed.

Reports to
: Director of Finance
Direct reports
: Finance Managers
Location
: Toronto, hybrid with 2 days in office
Status
: Full-time, permanent

What you’ll do

Financial operations and reporting

Oversee general ledger, bank reconciliations, payables, receivables and payroll
Prepare monthly and quarterly financial statements and variance reports for leadership and theAudit Committee
Keep fund and restricted-revenue accounting accurate, so every grant dollar is tracked to itspurpose

Grants and funder compliance

Prepare financial reports for government, foundation and corporate funders, on time and to their requirements
Partner with the development team on proposals and renewals
Support funder audits and site reviews

Audit, tax and compliance

Support the year-end audit and act as contact for the external auditors
Prepare or review the annual T3010 charity return, HST public-service-body rebates and other CRA filings

Controls, systems and team

Strengthen internal controls, approval policies and the finance procedures manual
Improve finance systems and reporting tools
Supervise, coach and develop the finance team
Act for the Director of Finance in their absence

What you bring

Required

CPA designation (or equivalent), in good standing
7+ years of progressive accounting experience, with at least 3 years supervising staff
Hands-on experience with fund accounting and restricted grants, ideally in a non-profit or charity
Experience leading or closely supporting a year-end audit
Advanced Excel skills and comfort with cloud accounting software
A knack for explaining numbers to people who don’t work in finance

Nice to have

Working knowledge of CRA charity rules, the T3010 and the Ontario Not-for-Profit Corporations Act
Experience reporting to government funders at the federal, provincial or municipal level
Experience improving systems or processes during organizational growth or change

What we offer

Competitive salary
Health plan
Pension
Flexible, hybrid work
A friendly, purpose-driven team where your work directly supports human rights and press freedom globally

How to apply

Send your resume and a short cover letter to careers@jhr.ca
by November 23 at 11:59 p.m. ET
. Tell us why this role, and our mission, matter to you.

JHR is committed to an inclusive, barrier-free hiring process. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and identities.

jobs.title: Vice President, Client Integration
jobs.description:
About Citco

JOB DESCRIPTION

Citco is a global leader in fund services, corporate governance and related asset services with staff across 50 office locations worldwide. With more than $1.8 trillion in assets under administration, we deliver end-to-end solutions and exceptional service to meet our clients’ needs.

For more information about Citco, please visit www.citco.com

About The Team & Business Line

Fund Administration is Citco’s core business, and our alternative asset and accounting services are among the industry’s most respected. Our continuous investment in learning and technology enables us to evolve our platforms and deliver scalable, effective solutions for our clients.

As a core member of our Client Integration team, you will work alongside accomplished professionals to help drive the evolution, integration and optimization of Citco’s platforms and operating models. Working across business, operations and technology, you will help shape solutions that improve connectivity, automation, scalability and the overall user and client experience.

Responsibilities

Your Role:

The Vice President will be a key leader in the execution of various strategic projects that support Citco Fund Services’ platform strategy.

The VP will be responsible for the successful delivery of projects- including new and existing platform initiatives. The individual is responsible for managing project teams made up of multiple owners from within Citco business units. The core skills required are having experience in leading teams for successful delivery of projects within a project management framework, demonstrating effective communication skills, understanding the financial services; client-facing experience is considered an asset.

The VP will ensure that new initiatives are established with the team’s agreed framework and assists the team in identifying scope and roles during the initiating of each project to ensure successful outcomes. Additionally, the incumbent will manage relationships with key stakeholders for each initiative as well as with indirect stakeholders, and is an escalation point as needed, lending expertise and guidance as required.

Own execution of multiple concurrent projects end to end
Manage/coordinate all work stream owners and deliverables
Manage stakeholder expectations and communications
Present project reporting and project plans to senior management
Clearly document and communicate business outcomes and gains from assigned initiatives
Review project reports to ensure validity

Support Senior VP in team oversight
Oversee execution of teams projects and governance tracking and tollgates
Ensure on-going review of team KPI and KRIs
Manage team reporting and marketing
Lead and develop staff

Qualifications

About You:

You are degree qualified or have a related professional qualification.
You have project manager qualifications (desirable).
You have a minimum of 5-6 years in the financial services industry.
You have a proven interest in the financial markets and hedge fund industry.
You have proven project management experience.
You have proven business analysis experience.
You have proven Microsoft Word and Excel, and PowerPoint skills.

Our Benefits

Your well-being is of paramount importance to us, and central to our success. We provide a range of benefits, training and education support, and flexible working arrangements to help you achieve success in your career while balancing personal needs. Ask us about specific benefits in your location.

We embrace diversity, prioritizing the hiring of people from diverse backgrounds. Our inclusive culture is a source of pride and strength, fostering innovation and mutual respect.

Citco welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection

jobs.title: Vice President, Marketing
jobs.description:
Cosmetic Physician Partners (CPP) is the largest practitioner-owned medical aesthetics network in the US. Founded in 2022, we have grown to 80+ clinics across the US. We are profitable, have already returned more than $60M to our investors, and are majority owned by our doctors, nurses and employees. No private equity.

Our model is simple: great practitioners lead their clinics, and CPP gives them the leadership team, support services and brand to grow faster than they could alone. We are looking for leaders who want to help write the next chapter.

MISSION

Own CPP’s marketing strategy and make it happen in every clinic. Set CPP clinics apart in the minds of consumers so our network grows faster than our peers, and do it in a way that our physicians, practice managers and marketing team trust and get behind.

THE ONE THING THAT MATTERS MOST

CPP owns its clinics, but we treat our physicians and practice managers like owners. This person earns their trust and the trust of our marketing team. Trust is earned by showing up with a sharp strategy, knowing digital inside out, rolling up your sleeves to deliver results, and building a team people want to be part of.

KEY OUTCOMES

1. Earn the trust of our physicians and practice managers

Partner, not vendor:
Build real working relationships with physicians and practice managers, and treat them like the owners they act as. Understand each clinic’s goals, patients and local market before recommending anything.
Speak their language:
Translate marketing into what clinics care about: new patients, rebooking, revenue per provider and return on spend. Explain the why behind every plan in plain terms.
Show up:
Visit clinics regularly, run clear monthly performance reviews and follow through on every commitment. Bad news early, good news with data.
Clinic-level guidance:
Give clinics practical playbooks they can run locally, and coach practice managers who are less familiar with marketing.

2. Earn the trust of our marketing team

Lead by example:
Be the person who can do the work, not just review it. Credibility comes from walking the talk.
Clear direction:
Set clear priorities, targets and ownership so everyone knows what winning looks like and how their work moves the numbers.
Back your people:
Remove roadblocks, give honest feedback, and give credit generously. Build a fun, drama-free team culture aligned with CPP values.

3. Clinic-level marketing strategy

Local brand positioning:
For each clinic, define how it stands out in its local market: who its patients are, what it is known for, and how it beats local competitors.
Clinic marketing plans:
Build a marketing plan for every clinic with the channels, budget and targets it needs to grow, created together with its physicians and practice manager.
Local presence:
Grow each clinic’s reputation in its community through reviews, local search, social media, events and referral partners.
Growth levers:
Drive both new patient acquisition and retention of existing patients (rebooking, visit frequency, loyalty) clinic by clinic.
Network advantage:
Use CPP’s scale, shared playbooks and annual promotional calendar to make every local brand stronger, and decide where in-house beats agencies.

4. Lead our digital marketing team

Lead digital experts:
Lead a team of digital marketing professionals across paid media, SEO, web, CRM and design. Know the craft deeply enough to coach and challenge each of them.
Set clear goals:
Set goals and targets for each person and channel, tied to clinic results like new patients and rebooking, and review progress with the team regularly.
Clear the path:
Help the team work through challenges, from underperforming campaigns to tech and data issues, and make the call when trade-offs are needed.
Translate digital:
Explain what is happening in plain language to physicians, practice managers and business operators: what we did, what it delivered and what comes next. No jargon.
Measurement:
Make sure tracking and dashboards are in place so results are clear and trusted by everyone.
AI in marketing:
Keep building AI into our marketing stack, from content and creative to targeting, reporting and patient journeys. Test new tools fast and scale what works.

5. Hands-on execution

Walk the talk:
Personally build campaigns, review ad accounts, write briefs and fix what is broken. This is a player-coach role.
Ship fast:
Launch, measure, learn and adjust quickly. Deliver results in months, not quarters.
Roll out at scale:
Take what works in one clinic and roll it out across the network, including new and acquired clinics.
Best practices:
Benchmark top-performing clinics and standardize what drives results.

6. Build and support teams

Build the team:
Hire, develop and retain a high-performance team of employees and contract partners.
Develop people:
Coach team members to grow in their roles, with regular 1-on-1s, clear goals and honest feedback.
Manage partners:
Hold agencies and vendors to clear targets, and bring work in-house where it makes sense.

WHAT YOU BRING

Experience:
10+ years in marketing, with 5+ years leading teams. Healthcare, medical aesthetics or wellness a strong plus.
Nice to have:
Multi-location consumer services experience, and agency-side experience.
Relationship skills:
A track record of earning the trust of operators, owners or clinicians who do not report to you, and getting them on board with change.
Strategic and digital depth:
Proven ability to build a marketing strategy and personally run digital channels to measurable growth.
Hands-on mindset:
Comfortable going from a board-level plan to the details of an ad account in the same day.
Data-driven:
Fluent with marketing analytics and comfortable making decisions from numbers, while staying close to people.
Communication:
Clear, simple and direct in writing and in person. French is a plus but not required.
Adaptable:
Thrives on change. Our business moves fast and priorities shift, and you adjust quickly without losing momentum.
AI-forward:
Excited about AI and already using it in your own work. You see it as a way to do more, faster and better.
CRM agnostic:
Experience with any major CRM or marketing automation platform. We care about results, not tools.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN YEAR ONE

Trusted by clinics:
Physicians and practice managers see you as a partner and ask for your input.
Trusted by the team:
The marketing team is engaged, clear on its targets and retaining its best people.
Clear plan:
A network-wide marketing strategy and budget is in place and understood by clinics.
Measurable growth:
New patient growth and patient retention are tracked monthly and trending ahead of target.

WHY JOIN CPP

Compensation:
Competitive package including health and dental benefits, and free medical aesthetic services from our network.
Equity:
Significant equity upside as we grow.
Fast growth:
Build alongside a proven leadership team in a profitable, fast-growing business.
Clear direction:
Very clear goals on what success looks like.
Culture:
We are clinic first, with a strong culture that values its people. A fun, drama-free workplace that rewards those who help build it.

PERKS & BENEFITS

RRSP Matching Program – Support for your long-term financial goals.
Summer Fridays – Enjoy half-day Fridays during the summer.
Comprehensive Benefits – 100% employer-paid base benefits plan.
Hybrid Work Environment – Flexibility to work both remotely and in the office.
Aesthetic Treatments – Access to treatments at our clinics.
Office Perks & Events – Snacks and refreshments, monthly team lunches, and quarterly team events.

Show more

Show less

Seniority level

Executive

Employment type

Full-time

Industries

Hospitals and Health Care

Aisance commerciale : expérience de la responsabilité ou de l'influence sur le P&L d'un produit, la tarification et le packaging, et prise de décisions d'investissement fondées sur les données
Historique de partenariats solides et collaboratifs avec la direction de l'ingénierie
Excellentes qualités de communication, capacité à inspirer, à influencer et à responsabiliser

Expertise du secteur des énergies renouvelables

Connaissance approfondie du secteur des énergies renouvelables, par exemple en matière de performance des actifs, d'exploitation, de finance ou de logiciels pour l'énergie. Nous étudierons aussi les profils de dirigeants produit exceptionnels capables d'apprendre rapidement, mais une expertise sectorielle approfondie est un véritable atout

Exposition au Conseil d'administration (souhaitée, non obligatoire)

Expérience préalable au sein d'un comité exécutif et auprès d'un Conseil d'administration. Nous accueillons volontiers les leaders en devenir dont le parcours et la motivation montrent qu'ils sont prêts à franchir cette étape

Qui vous êtes

Un expert de votre métier, avec un impact avéré et l'humilité de continuer à apprendre
Animé par l'envie de faire la différence et motivé par la mission d'accélérer la transition vers les énergies renouvelables
Enthousiaste à l'idée de rejoindre un leader de sa catégorie et prêt à vous engager sur le long terme
Un bâtisseur et un pédagogue, qui fait grandir son entourage

Comment le succès sera mesuré

Des product owners disposant d'une visibilité claire sur le P&L et assumant leur responsabilité sur l'ensemble du portefeuille
Un processus de gestion de produit mature et appliqué de manière cohérente
Une croissance mesurable du chiffre d'affaires produit, de l'adoption, de la fidélisation et de la marge
Un partenariat de grande confiance et à haute vélocité avec le CTO, ainsi qu'une équipe produit engagée et fidélisée

LA VIE CHEZ POWER FACTORS

Nous sommes une entreprise de développement logiciel agile : assez grande pour avoir un impact, assez petite pour aller vite et exécuter dans un secteur en pleine croissance. Nous sommes une équipe de talents audacieux et ingénieux, animés par les résultats. Nous sommes passionnés par l'idée de rendre le monde meilleur. Nous recherchons des personnes ambitieuses et humbles pour nous aider à réaliser notre plan.

POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE

En rejoignant l'équipe de Power Factors, vous ferez partie d'un groupe dynamique de personnes innovantes et motivées, engagées à avoir un impact positif. Chaque jour, votre travail contribuera directement à l'avancement des solutions d'énergie propre et au soutien des initiatives mondiales de durabilité. Notre culture est profondément ancrée et se reflète dans notre façon de travailler ensemble : engagés, consciencieux et collaboratifs. Avec de nombreuses opportunités d'évolution professionnelle, Power Factors vous accompagne dans votre développement alors que nous menons la transformation du secteur de l'énergie.

EMPLOYEUR GARANTISSANT L'ÉGALITÉ DES CHANCES

Power Factors est un employeur garantissant l'égalité des chances, engagé à rassembler une main-d'œuvre diversifiée et à entretenir une culture inclusive. Toutes les candidatures qualifiées seront examinées sans considération de race, de couleur, de religion, de sexe, d'orientation sexuelle, d'identité de genre, d'origine nationale, de handicap ou de statut d'ancien combattant.

About Power Factors

Power Factors is a software and solutions provider leading the next generation of clean energy with Unity, one of the most extensive and widely deployed renewable energy management suites (REMS) in the market. With over 300 GW of wind, solar, and energy storage assets managed worldwide across more than 600 customers and 18,000 sites, Power Factors manages 25% of the world's renewable energy data.*

Power Factors' Unity REMS supports the entire energy value chain, from monitoring and controls to market analytics. The company's suite of open, data-driven applications empowers renewable energy stakeholders to collaborate, automate critical workflows, and make more informed decisions to maximize asset returns. Energy stakeholders receive end-to-end support, including solutions for SCADA & PPC, centralized monitoring, performance management, commercial asset management, and field service management.

With deep domain expertise, AI-powered insights are delivered at scale so businesses can optimize assets, unlock growth, and make smarter decisions as the world rapidly transitions to clean energy. Power Factors fights climate change with code.

Outside China and India

About The Role

PowerFactors is a category-leading software company serving the renewable energy industry. We are hiring a Chief Product Officer to own product strategy, process and performance across our portfolio, and to transform product management into a true ownership model.

Our ambition is for every product to be run by a product owner who understands the revenue it generates, the cost to build and serve it, and the return it delivers. The CPO will build that capability, inspire the team to embrace it, and be accountable for the results. This is a multi-year commitment to shape the company's next chapter.

The Critical Partnership

The CPO and Chief Technology Officer are two halves of one engine. The CPO owns what we build and why: strategy, customer value, prioritization, commercial outcomes and product P&L. The CTO owns how it is built and delivered: engineering, architecture and development execution. Success depends on shared goals, mutual trust, and a joint operating rhythm that turns strategy into shipped, adopted, profitable product. Candidates should show a track record of exceptional partnership with technology leaders.

What You Will Do

Lead product strategy. Define and communicate a clear, customer-driven vision and multi-year roadmap that extends our leadership in renewables
Build a product-owner culture. Evolve the organization from to accountable product ownership, with each owner responsible for outcomes, not outputs
Establish P&L oversight. Partner with Finance to give every product owner transparent visibility of revenue, margin and cost structure, and to make investment, pricing and sunset decisions on that basis
Drive product management excellence. Institute disciplined, scalable processes for discovery, prioritization, roadmapping, launch, and lifecycle management, with clear metrics
Partner with the CTO. Co-create the operating model, planning cadence and decision rights

new_jobs.title: Deputy Finance Director
new_jobs.description:
Journalists for Human Rights (JHR) is a Toronto-based non-profit that trains journalists, media outlets, civil society organizations, and other stakeholders across the globe. Our work is pivotal in creating an environment where objective media can thrive, ensuring that public voices are heard and respected.
The Deputy Director of Finance is our second-most senior finance leader, reporting to the Director of Finance. You’ll run day-to-day finance operations and also step in for the Director when needed.

Reports to
: Director of Finance
Direct reports
: Finance Managers
Location
: Toronto, hybrid with 2 days in office
Status
: Full-time, permanent

What you’ll do

Financial operations and reporting

Oversee general ledger, bank reconciliations, payables, receivables and payroll
Prepare monthly and quarterly financial statements and variance reports for leadership and theAudit Committee
Keep fund and restricted-revenue accounting accurate, so every grant dollar is tracked to itspurpose

Grants and funder compliance

Prepare financial reports for government, foundation and corporate funders, on time and to their requirements
Partner with the development team on proposals and renewals
Support funder audits and site reviews

Audit, tax and compliance

Support the year-end audit and act as contact for the external auditors
Prepare or review the annual T3010 charity return, HST public-service-body rebates and other CRA filings

Controls, systems and team

Strengthen internal controls, approval policies and the finance procedures manual
Improve finance systems and reporting tools
Supervise, coach and develop the finance team
Act for the Director of Finance in their absence

What you bring

Required

CPA designation (or equivalent), in good standing
7+ years of progressive accounting experience, with at least 3 years supervising staff
Hands-on experience with fund accounting and restricted grants, ideally in a non-profit or charity
Experience leading or closely supporting a year-end audit
Advanced Excel skills and comfort with cloud accounting software
A knack for explaining numbers to people who don’t work in finance

Nice to have

Working knowledge of CRA charity rules, the T3010 and the Ontario Not-for-Profit Corporations Act
Experience reporting to government funders at the federal, provincial or municipal level
Experience improving systems or processes during organizational growth or change

What we offer

Competitive salary
Health plan
Pension
Flexible, hybrid work
A friendly, purpose-driven team where your work directly supports human rights and press freedom globally

How to apply

Send your resume and a short cover letter to careers@jhr.ca
by November 23 at 11:59 p.m. ET
. Tell us why this role, and our mission, matter to you.

JHR is committed to an inclusive, barrier-free hiring process. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and identities.

new_jobs.description:
About Citco

JOB DESCRIPTION

Citco is a global leader in fund services, corporate governance and related asset services with staff across 50 office locations worldwide. With more than $1.8 trillion in assets under administration, we deliver end-to-end solutions and exceptional service to meet our clients’ needs.

For more information about Citco, please visit www.citco.com

About The Team & Business Line

Fund Administration is Citco’s core business, and our alternative asset and accounting services are among the industry’s most respected. Our continuous investment in learning and technology enables us to evolve our platforms and deliver scalable, effective solutions for our clients.

As a core member of our Client Integration team, you will work alongside accomplished professionals to help drive the evolution, integration and optimization of Citco’s platforms and operating models. Working across business, operations and technology, you will help shape solutions that improve connectivity, automation, scalability and the overall user and client experience.

Responsibilities

Your Role:

The Vice President will be a key leader in the execution of various strategic projects that support Citco Fund Services’ platform strategy.

The VP will be responsible for the successful delivery of projects- including new and existing platform initiatives. The individual is responsible for managing project teams made up of multiple owners from within Citco business units. The core skills required are having experience in leading teams for successful delivery of projects within a project management framework, demonstrating effective communication skills, understanding the financial services; client-facing experience is considered an asset.

The VP will ensure that new initiatives are established with the team’s agreed framework and assists the team in identifying scope and roles during the initiating of each project to ensure successful outcomes. Additionally, the incumbent will manage relationships with key stakeholders for each initiative as well as with indirect stakeholders, and is an escalation point as needed, lending expertise and guidance as required.

Own execution of multiple concurrent projects end to end
Manage/coordinate all work stream owners and deliverables
Manage stakeholder expectations and communications
Present project reporting and project plans to senior management
Clearly document and communicate business outcomes and gains from assigned initiatives
Review project reports to ensure validity

Support Senior VP in team oversight
Oversee execution of teams projects and governance tracking and tollgates
Ensure on-going review of team KPI and KRIs
Manage team reporting and marketing
Lead and develop staff

Qualifications

About You:

You are degree qualified or have a related professional qualification.
You have project manager qualifications (desirable).
You have a minimum of 5-6 years in the financial services industry.
You have a proven interest in the financial markets and hedge fund industry.
You have proven project management experience.
You have proven business analysis experience.
You have proven Microsoft Word and Excel, and PowerPoint skills.

Our Benefits

Your well-being is of paramount importance to us, and central to our success. We provide a range of benefits, training and education support, and flexible working arrangements to help you achieve success in your career while balancing personal needs. Ask us about specific benefits in your location.

We embrace diversity, prioritizing the hiring of people from diverse backgrounds. Our inclusive culture is a source of pride and strength, fostering innovation and mutual respect.

Citco welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection
